info.title: Generative APIs - Consumption Limits API
info.description:
The Scaleway Generative APIs - Consumption Limits API allows you to configure fine- grained capacity both inside your Project and at the user level:

- Configure a secondary rate limit quota per minute that applies to a Project.
- Configure a daily and/or monthly consumption limit budget per principal inside a Project.

## Concepts

While the Scaleway quota applies to the entire Organization, the Consumption Limits API allows you to slice this quota across your different Projects.

A consumption limit exists for each Project and model inside the Organization, and it is disabled by default.

The consumption limit object is uniquely identified by its model name, project ID, and organization ID.

You can allocate a fixed daily or monthly resource budget for each user or principal member of the scoped Project.

Each limit is configurable individually.

## Quickstart

1. Configure your environment variables.

   ```bash
   export SCW_SECRET_KEY="<API secret key>"
   ```

2. **List current consumption limits**: Run the following command to get a list of all consumption limits:

   ```bash
   curl -X GET \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -H "X-Auth-Token: $SCW_SECRET_KEY" \
     "https://api.scaleway.com/generative-apis/v1/consumption-limits?project_id=11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
   ```

   The consumption-limits endpoint accepts either an `organization_id` or a `project_id` (only one of the two), and optionally a `model_id` filter. It returns a list of consumption limits under the `consumption_limits` key, each containing the `model_id`, `organization_id`, `project_id`, and its `limits`:

   ```json
   {
     "consumption_limits": [
       {
         "model_id": "qwen3.8-audio",
         "organization_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
         "project_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
         "limits": [
           {
             "processing_unit": "token",
             "organization_rate_limit":  5000000,
             "project_rate_limit": { "enabled": true, "value": 1000000 },
             "user_daily_budget": { "enabled": true, "value": 50000000 },
             "user_monthly_budget": { "enabled": true, "value": 1000000000 }
           },
           {
             "processing_unit": "audio_second",
             "organization_rate_limit":  5000000,
             "project_rate_limit": { "enabled": false, "value": 0 },
             "user_daily_budget": { "enabled": false, "value": 0 },
             "user_monthly_budget": { "enabled": false, "value": 0 }
           }
         ]
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

3. **Update a consumption limit**: Run the following command to update a consumption limit. The request body must contain the `model_id` and `project_id`, and the `limits` parameter that needs to be edited.

Customize the details in the payload to fit your needs:

   ```bash
   curl -X PATCH https://api.scaleway.com/generative-apis/v1/consumption-limits \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -H "X-Auth-Token: $SCW_SECRET_KEY" \
   -d '{
     "model_id": "qwen3.8-audio",
     "project_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
     "limits": [
       {
         "processing_unit": "token",
         "project_rate_limit": {
           "enabled": true,
           "value": 2000000
         }
       },
       {
         "processing_unit": "audio_second",
         "project_rate_limit": {
           "enabled": true,
           "value": 1800
         },
         "user_daily_budget": {
           "enabled": true,
           "value": 2000000
         },
         "user_monthly_budget": {
           "enabled": true,
           "value": 40000000
         }
       }
     ]
   }'
   ```

   This is a partial update: for a given `processing_unit`, any limit field you omit is left unchanged (its previous value is preserved). In the example, only `project_rate_limit` is sent for the `token` processing unit, so its `user_daily_budget` and `user_monthly_budget` are kept as they were. Entries whose `processing_unit` is not present in the request are not modified. To disable a limit, send `{ "enabled": false }`. To change only the `value` of a limit, re-send its current `enabled` value alongside the new `value`.

   | Parameter             | Description                                                                                                   | Valid values                                                                  |
   | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
   | `model_id`            | The model name to which the consumption limit applies (string)                                                 | Any valid model ID found in the OpenAI compatible API endpoint `/v1/models`   |
   | `project_id`          | The Project in which the consumption limit is edited (string)                                                 | Any valid Scaleway Project ID, e.g., `"b4bd99e0-b389-11ed-afa1-0242ac120002"` |
   | `processing_unit`     | The processing unit to which the limit applies (string enum)                                                   | `token`, `audio_second`                                                       |
   | `project_rate_limit`  | Rate limit quota that applies to the Project (if enabled, must be less than or equal to your Organization rate limit) | Object with `enabled` (bool) and `value` (int)                                |
   | `user_daily_budget`   | The maximum amount of processing units a user is allowed to consume daily                                     | Object with `enabled` (bool) and `value` (int)                                |
   | `user_monthly_budget` | The maximum amount of processing units a user is allowed to consume monthly                                    | Object with `enabled` (bool) and `value` (int)                                |

Each of `project_rate_limit`, `user_daily_budget` and `user_monthly_budget` is a limit object with two fields:

- `enabled` (bool): specifies whether the limit is enforced. When `false`, the limit is not applied.
- `value` (int): the limit value in processing units. For `project_rate_limit`, the value is expressed per minute and must be less than or equal to your Organization rate limit. For `user_daily_budget` and `user_monthly_budget`, the value is the total amount of processing units allowed over the day/month, respectively.

tags.name: Consumption Limits
tags.description: A consumption limit can be configured at the organization, project, or user level.

organization_rate_limit.description: Rate limit quota per minute applied across the entire Organization.

project_rate_limit.description: Secondary rate limit quota per minute applied to the Project.

enabled.description: Specify whether or not to enable the limit.

value.description: The amount of processing units to allocate for this limit.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Order in which to return results.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of consumption limits to return per page.

model_id.description: The model name to configure the consumption limit for.

limits.description: The ConsumptionLimits objects to configure for this model and Project.
